S02 E03 — The One Where Heckles Dies
Monica and Rachel's grumpy downstairs neighbor (Larry Hankin) dies and leaves all his belongings to the girls.

title: Friends
description:
S02 E04 — The One With Phoebe's Husband
The group is amazed when Phoebe marries a Canadian ice dancer (Steve Zahn) to help him get his green card.

title: Friends
description:
S02 E05 — The One With Five Steaks and an Eggplant
The group's plans of throwing a birthday party are marred when money becomes an issue; Monica gets a promotion; Chandler sets a woman up to get a date with her, but a case of mistaken identities means that he discovers what she really thought of him.

title: The Big Bang Theory
description:
S09 E15 — The Valentino Submergence
Amy and Sheldon host a Valentine's Day edition of Fun With Flags; Penny and Leonard wrestle with getting older; Howard and Bernadette make a discovery in their hot tub; Raj is torn between Emily and another woman.

title: The Big Bang Theory
description:
S09 E16 — The Positive Negative Reaction
The gang celebrates news of Bernadette's pregnancy by singing karaoke; Wolowitz's reaction to the pregnancy announcement worries Bernadette; Wolowitz believes he needs to make more money to support his growing family.

title: The Big Bang Theory
description:
S09 E17 — The Celebration Experimentation
For the first time in nine years, the gang celebrates Sheldon's birthday -- surprising him with a special guest.

title: The Big Bang Theory
description:
S09 E18 — The Application Deterioration
Leonard, Sheldon and Wolowitz file for a patent on their new invention; Penny, Amy and Bernadette give dating advice to Koothrappali after his breakup with Emily.

title: The Big Bang Theory
description:
S09 E19 — The Solder Excursion Diversion
Sheldon makes a surprise revelation when Amy buys him a new laptop; Leonard and Wolowitz get sold out by Koothrappali after lying to their wives to attend a movie screening.

title: The Big Bang Theory
description:
S09 E20 — The Big Bear Precipitation
Sheldon shares a secret about Leonard when the two go on a weekend trip with Penny and Amy; Koothrappali goes all out with pregnancy gifts.

title: The Big Bang Theory
description:
S09 E21 — The Viewing Party Combustion
During a group get-together, a minor argument between Sheldon and Leonard turns into a heated debate, leaving the rest of the gang to choose sides.

title: The Big Bang Theory
description:
S09 E22 — The Fermentation Bifurcation
The gang runs into Penny's old boyfriend while out at a wine bar; Bernadette spends an evening with Sheldon; Koothrappali's introduction of his new girlfriend doesn't go as planned.

title: The Big Bang Theory
description:
S09 E23 — The Line Substitution Solution
Sheldon wants to go to a movie screening, so he pays Stuart to spend the day with Amy; Penny has a difficult time connecting with Leonard's visiting mother.

title: The Big Bang Theory
description:
S09 E24 — The Convergence Convergence
Leonard's recently divorced parents and Sheldon's devoutly religious mother visit; when they are contacted about their guidance system, Wolowitz and Koothrappali think the government is after them.

title: The Big Bang Theory
description:
S10 E01 — The Conjugal Conjecture
The group struggles through an awkward morning after Sheldon's mother and Leonard's father spend an evening together; Penny's family arrives.

title: The Big Bang Theory
description:
S10 E02 — The Military Miniaturization
Wolowitz has a meeting with Colonel Williams, a representative from the Air Force Department of Material Command.
